name: Head Chef Droid
description: The patented Head Chef Droid was a J4-SN Chef Droid owned by Hutt Cartel members Gaboorga the Abundant and Duuba the Magnanimous, serving as Head Chef of The Sarlacc Pit cantina and Bog's Bounty Banquet Hall during the Feast of Prosperity on Nar Shaddaa in 3626 BBY.
